name: hermes_safe_arbitrage_intent
description: Registers an arbitrage swap-path intent. Generates ZERO execution payloads directly from the LLM; only typed trading pairs are parsed for local evaluation. The local execution layer owns calldata generation, on-chain simulation (read-only eth_call: router has code + live Uniswap V3 pool exists at a real fee tier via Factory.getPool + pool.slot0), risk gating, and human approval. The LLM can never supply raw calldata, a target contract, or a transaction hash. Broadcast (if ever enabled) is delegated to the Base Account smart wallet, which requires per-tx tap-approve.

sourceToken.description: The ERC20 contract address of the input token on Base (e.g. WETH 0x4200...0006, USDC 0x8335...2913). Must be a valid 20-byte hex address; validated against the local blocklist and risk gate before any action.

targetToken.description: The ERC20 contract address of the output token on Base. Must differ from sourceToken and pass the same validation.

inputAmountWei.description: The exact input size denominated in wei as a base-10 integer string (e.g. "50000000000000000" for 0.05 ETH) to preserve precision. Validated as a non-negative integer > 0.

venue.description: Enforces execution strictly through authorized local protocol integrations. Mapped to a verified router allowlist; any other value is rejected.
